summary: The payment service container has exited (exit code 137), which is causing checkout operations to fail. This has led to cascading failures and high latency across the frontend and other services. Additionally, the product-catalog service is unhealthy, further degrading system performance.
symptoms: Checkout service failing with 100% error rate.
High p95 latency on frontend-proxy and other services.
Product-catalog service unhealthy and traffic drop.

root_cause.description: The payment service container has exited (code 137), causing checkout failures and cascading issues across the system.

evidence.explanation: The payment container is in an exited state with exit code 137, indicating it was killed (likely OOM or SIGKILL).

The checkout service is failing with 100% error rate, and traces show it is unable to connect to dependencies like the shipping service due to DNS/network timeouts, and cart service due to connection errors. The payment service being down is a critical dependency for checkout.
evidence.quote: 13 INTERNAL: shipping quote failure: failed POST to shipping service: Post \"http://shipping:50050/get-quote\": dial tcp: lookup shipping on 127.0.0.11:53: dial udp 127.0.0.11:53: i/o timeout

evidence.explanation: The product-catalog service is unhealthy and experiencing traffic drops, contributing to the overall system instability.
evidence.quote: "product-catalog": {"rps": 0.205, "error_rate": 0.0, "p95_ms": 15000.0, "baseline_rps": 2.828, "baseline_error_rate": 0.0, "baseline_p95_ms": 13592.9, "note": "traffic dropped sharply vs baseline (service may be down or unreachable)"}

ruled_out: The frontend service is not the root cause; it is failing because its downstream dependencies (checkout, product-catalog) are failing.
The load-generator is not the root cause; it is just reporting the failures.

proposed_action.expected_outcome: The payment service container should restart and begin processing checkout requests, resolving the cascading failures.
proposed_action.reason: The payment service container exited with code 137, indicating it was terminated (likely OOM). Restarting the service is the standard procedure for a service_down incident.

prevention: Investigate why the payment service was killed (exit code 137) and ensure it has sufficient resources. Improve resilience in the checkout service to handle dependency failures gracefully. Investigate the health of the product-catalog service.
